mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_publication_requests (token_hash, user_id, agent_id, repository_id, head_commit, metadata_hash, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{userId}, #{agentId}, #{repositoryId}, #{headCommit}, #{metadataHash}, #{status}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_publication_requests SET status = #{status}, decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
